The '''Dashades''' were a [[Species/Legends|race]] of large reptilian [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] notable for their resistance to the powers of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Dashade-UAA.png|thumb|left|140px|A cloaked Dashade]]
Dashade were large reptilians with dark skin, lamprey-like mouths and powerful claws. In addition to their partial Force resistance, they were resistant to radiation. They also had an ability to dissipate heat, which made them hard to detect using standard [[Life-form scanner/Legends|life-form sensors]].<ref name="Dashade in the Databank" />

==Society and culture==
Thanks to their resistance to the Force, Dashade warriors easily found employment as combat instructors for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and assassins for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Dashade in the Databank" /> They also used their natural abilities to their advantage as elite [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and among similar professions.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

Some common Dashade names were Ket Maliss,<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> Alaris Koth, Nos Kellex, Tel Sorath, and Tessun Kel.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==History==
[[File:KhemVal-TOR.png|thumb|right|Khem Val, a Dashade]]
The Dashade homeworld, [[Urkupp]], was destroyed in [[3996 BBY]] when the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] supernova [[Cron Supernova/Legends|exploded]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], wiping out the vast majority of the Dashade. Though they were rendered nearly extinct, remnant populations were seen sporadically for millennia.

One survivor of the destruction of Urkupp was [[Snar Extruct]], a warrior who befriended the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Skarch Vaunk]]. Extruct moved to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], becoming the sparring partner of Vaunk.<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>
Thirty-eight Dashade [[Shadow Killer]]s, retainers of a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] royal house, were among the off-world survivors. In order to preserve these elite warriors, they were placed in cryogenic suspension, to be revived one at a time when needed for special assignments. The Dashade [[Khem Val]], a former servant of the ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Tulak Hord]], survived on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Khem would be made to serve a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]], who rose rapidly within the upper echelons of Sith society and would later come to be known as [[Darth Nox]]. Ironically, Nox was a descendant of Lord [[Aloysius Kallig]], a Sith that Tulak Hord had betrayed in life. [[Veshikk Urk]], a rival of Khem and a fellow Dashade assassin, was a servant of [[Ortan Cela]], an apprentice of Tulak Hord. Like Khem, Veshikk also survived up to the Cold War, but would gain subservient Sith followers instead of being made to serve one, eventually relocating to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Akriss Veng]], another Shadow Killer, had also survived into the Cold War and his stasis chamber would be brought aboard the [[Arcanum]]. Akriss would eventually be freed by the Sith Lord [[Tagriss]], who led a detachment of the [[Dread Host]] to attack the Arcanum. However, this freedom would be short-lived, as an Imperial spacer killed Akriss almost immediately afterwards.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a Dashade could be spotted on a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] broadcast in Coruscant's [[Desrini District]].<ref>{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|news/1359_3.html|Desrini Plagued by Dianogas}}</ref>

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], only one known Dashade remained, [[Ket Maliss]]. Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], a descendant of the royals who had passed the Dashade down over the generations, inherited this warrior and made him an assassin for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="Dashade in the Databank" />

Around [[3631 BBY]], a Dashade known as [[Ak'ghal Usar]] was released on [[Yavin 4]] by the [[Outlander]]. After being subdued, Usar revealed that he had come to the moon in hopes of destroying [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], who was believed to have destroyed Urkupp and its Dashade population. However, Usar's mission was prevented when he was captured by a being known as the "black-eyed Sith," whose real identity was that of [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]]. After learning that neither Valkorion nor Kun possessed a physical body to attack, Usar offered his services to the Outlander, which were either accepted or rejected.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

[[File:Dashade_squad_leader-_GAW.jpg|thumb|left|A Dashade squad leader in combat]]
There was also evidence that Dashade mercenaries participated in the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="Dashade in the Databank" />

Some believed that the Dashade may have founded colonies before Urkupp's destruction.<ref name="Dashade in the Databank" /> [[New Republic Security Force|New Republic Security]] became concerned that these lost colonies may have started working for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and in the criminal underworld. To assuage their fears, they dispatched a number of spacers to scout uninhabited star systems close to [[Nova/Legends|novas]], [[Supernova/Legends|supernovas]], highly charged gas clouds, and even tide-locked worlds from binary star systems. They supplied ships and a mobile [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transceiver to aid them. It is unclear what discoveries were made from these endeavors.<ref name="Alien Adventures on Wizards.com">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20011101c|text=Alien Adventures|int=Alien Adventures}}</ref>
